text: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), a research-supported type of psychotherapy, is commonly used to treat social anxiety disorder. CBT teaches a person different ways of thinking, behaving, and reacting to situations to help them feel less anxious and fearful. CBT also can help a person learn and practice social skills, which is very important for treating social anxiety disorder. CBT has been well studied and is the “gold standard” choice for psychotherapy.
